newsitem.title: UK: DLJ in talks to buy British firm-paper.
newsitem.headline: DLJ in talks to buy British firm-paper.

text.p: New York-based Brokerage Donaldson Lufkin & Jenrette is poised to buy privately owned British corporate finance boutique Phoenix Securities, according to a report in the Sunday Telegraph newspaper.

The paper said the acquisition could be worth 50 million pounds ($81.7 million) and came after a record-breaking year in which Phoenix made a profit of 2 million pounds ($3.3 million) after advising on a string of high-profile deals.
The Sunday Telegraph said Donaldson Lufkin & Jenrette was in the process of building up its presence in London.
